semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Zhejiang Planary Electronic Materials Co., Ltd. provides comprehensive solutions for material planarization in the semiconductor industry, focusing on CMP materials. The company offers silica sol, polishing slurry, and polishing pads, which are utilized in various CMP processes for silicon carbide and silicon substrates.
capabilities: Polishing slurry for silicon carbide substrate CMP
Polishing pads for integrated circuit CMP

regional_presence.China: The company has multiple subsidiaries in China, including R&D centers and a production base.
